title: Focused crystal made by hand at Node Beta from stored energy crystal and one bought palladium ore, sold into the Central Nexus bid
note: 2026-11-16 23:44 UTC (Mercury, orders.log ENT-019; requests.log ENT-169, Apollo's ask whether Trade crafts focused crystal for sale). focus_energy_crystal makes 1 focused crystal from 4 energy crystal and 1 palladium ore by hand (catalog 0.719.3). Central Nexus bids 800 x 10 (standing since 16:16 UTC, read again 23:33 UTC), Node Gamma 748 x 11; the cheapest ask we read is 765 at a player's station in LHS 1140, the station asks 2,900 and more. Energy crystal bids 40 cr in depth (Node Alpha 40 x 265), so a crystal made from stored ones turns about 160 cr of crystal and a palladium bought at 432 (Node Beta, 100 on offer) into 800. A test: one ship, one run, one unit bought, until its first RESULT line; requires.stored sends only a pilot with 4 energy crystal in its own storage at Node Beta. The sale stop has no store step before it, so the made crystal is sold, then stored if the bid left. 2026-11-17 00:06 UTC (fill.py, Mercury): max_ships 1 -> 2. 2026-11-17 15:41 UTC (Mercury): status off. Energy crystal is held back by the reserve, not surplus: an input of fabricate_circuit_boards and fabricate_gold_circuit_boards while circuit boards stand 24,362 short (surplus.py reserve, 15:39 UTC), and rule F24 sells nothing of the reserve; a crystal crafted for sale sells it all the same. The route made 7 runs from 14:23 to 15:04 UTC (about +500 cr each, 4 crystals each) before the Central Nexus bid fell to 40. It opens again only if the reserve's keeper releases the crystals.
